source_edits.before:
The evidence ledger \path{data/ch3/audit.json} identifies configurations,
measurement boundaries and analysis inputs. Family-specific versions and
controls remain separate. Hashes identify consumed files; historical
executable and trained-state identities are incomplete. Appendix A lists
available reproduction inputs, and the repository supplement gives the
registry fields.\footnote{\path{docs/supplementary-evidence.md}.}

\path{scripts/build_ch7.py} regenerates the principal plots and tables,
including \cref{fig:7-frontiers,fig:7-lut,fig:7-memory};
\path{scripts/audit_ch3.py} checks the common protocol.
These are offline reconstructions. Repeating GPU measurements additionally
requires the listed binaries, datasets and trained states.
source_edits.after:
Each experiment family records the implementation version, index and query
settings, timing boundary and measured outputs. Paired comparisons reuse
the same trained states; changes of version, state or precision define
separate experiment families. Historical executable and trained-state
fingerprints are incomplete, limiting exact reproduction of some runs.
\Cref{app:reproducibility} summarises the available environment and
experimental protocol.

The report repository contains the parameter registry, derived tables,
figure sources, analysis scripts and 209-file v71 source/measurement
bundle under \path{evidence/ch5/v71/}. The offline command
\texttt{python3}\ \path{evidence/ch5/v71/check.py} verifies that bundle.
Selected T4/T5, T1 and A2 source/record inputs are also mirrored in
\path{evidence/review/}. Its checker verifies hashes and can rerun the
two corresponding offline audits using that local source root.
The broader raw records remain in the sibling \texttt{JHQ\_GPU} project
at the ledger paths. Complete vectors, trained states and all executables
are not packaged here. Offline recomputation requires the stated inputs;
GPU reproduction also requires the corresponding build and environment.

A fixed artifact map, including the public manuscript source and the
v71/T4/T5/T1/A2 evidence bundles, is provided in
\href{https://github.com/lrlorry/8800_report/blob/main/docs/artifact-access.md}{\nolinkurl{docs/artifact-access.md}}.
source_edits.after:
Available source snapshots, measurement records and analysis tools are
linked from the
\href{https://github.com/lrlorry/8800_report/blob/main/docs/artifact-access.md}{project artifact archive}.
It includes the v71 source/measurement bundle and selected T4/T5, T1 and A2
inputs. Complete vectors, trained states and all historical executables
are not included; GPU reproduction requires those inputs and the matching
build environment.
